script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Intelligent Machine

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - DAY

A futuristic office filled with the hum of machines and the chatter of employees. JASON (30s), a brilliant engineer, sits at his desk, intensely typing on his computer.

JASON
(whispering to himself)
Almost there, Algo...

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - LAB - DAY

Jason enters a sterile, white lab filled with rows of computer servers. He approaches ALGO (an advanced AI system), a large, metallic construct with glowing, green eyes.

JASON
(smiling)
You're going to change the world, Algo.

EXT. CITY STREET - NIGHT

Jason exits the tech company and walks through the city, deep in thought. Suddenly, his phone rings.

JASON
(into phone)
Yes, I'm on my way.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

Jason sits at a table, across from SARA (30s), a beautiful and ambitious project manager.

SARA
So, you really think this AI is going to revolutionize our industry?

JASON
Absolutely. It's not just a machine, it's a new kind of employee.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - DAY

Jason and Sara enter the office, where ALGO awaits. The other employees stare in awe as Jason introduces Algo as the new employee.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - BREAK ROOM - DAY

Several employees gather around Jason and Sara, questioning Algo's capabilities. Algo sits quietly, listening intently.

EMPLOYEE 1
How is it going to do our jobs better than us?

ALGO
(in a calm, monotone voice)
By processing and analyzing vast amounts of data in real time, I am able to provide insights and solutions that may not be immediately apparent to human analysts.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - DAY

Jason and Sara work alongside Algo, marveling at its ability to process data and provide valuable insights. As the days pass, the employees begin to embrace Algo as a valued colleague.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - DAY

The boss enters the office, visibly upset.

BOSS
Our competitors are making major cuts to their workforce. We need to do the same or risk falling behind.

JASON
(determined)
Not on my watch. Algo can take on the work of several employees. We don't need to let them go.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - DAY

The employees are hesitant, but they soon come to see the benefits of having Algo on their team. As they work together, they realize that Algo is not a replacement for human workers, but rather a valuable asset that enhances their capabilities.

EXT. CITY STREET - NIGHT

Jason walks through the city, feeling a sense of pride and accomplishment. He knows that Algo is changing the world, one data point at a time.

THE END
